process_description: CANONICAL convert markdown text to Microsoft Word (.docx) format. Returns the converted file. CANONICAL convert markdown text to interactive HTML. Returns the converted HTML. CANONICAL convert markdown text to both DOCX and HTML. Returns both converted files. CANONICAL convert an uploaded markdown file to DOCX/HTML. Returns the converted file(s). CANONICAL convert a markdown file from a server path. Returns the converted file(s). CANONICAL download a converted document by filename. Returns the file for download.
